summary: Southwestern Electric Power Company, a Delaware-incorporated AEP utility subsidiary, filed an 8-K reporting an Underwriting Agreement dated September 14, 2026 with CIBC World Markets, Fifth Third Securities, J.P. Morgan Securities and U.S. Bancorp Investments as representatives, covering the sale of $750,000,000 of 6.00% Senior Notes, Series S, due 2037. The notes were issued under a supplemental indenture with Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company as trustee, drawn from an existing $2.25 billion shelf. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; no equity, premium, or change-of-control terms arise. Watch only spread and rate risk.
